translations.web: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
translations.bsb: Turn Your steps to the everlasting ruins, to everything in the sanctuary the enemy has destroyed.
translations.kjv: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.
